Schedule of updates and announcements for HMRC's statistics

Publication plan for HMRC National and Official Statistics. Any changes to the schedule will be detailed in the announcements.

From:
HM Revenue & Customs
Published:
16 December 2013
Last updated:
28 August 2026 — See all updates

2025 HMRC statistics announcements

Publication plan for HMRC National Statistics and official statistics: April 2025 to March 2026

HTML

Details

Exact dates of HMRC’s statistics are announced no later than 4 weeks in advance on the statistics release calendar. As part of the Code of Practice for Statistics, any changes to the schedule will be stated and detailed in the announcements page.

Announcements for previous years can be found on The National Archives.

Updates to this page

Published 16 December 2013
Last updated 28 August 2026 — Show all updates
  1. 28 August 2026

    Change of timing for annual Tax Relief Statistics.

  2. 7 August 2026

    New release date for Creative Industry Annual Tax Relief statistics

  3. 13 July 2026

    HMRC have announced the upcoming release of 'UK import trade in goods by country of origin and country of dispatch, 2025'.

  4. 9 July 2026

    HMRC plans to stop publishing the Preliminary Estimate and Second Estimate of the VAT gap, commencing Autumn 2026.   We will continue to publish a single estimate as part of the annual Measuring Tax Gaps Official Statistics publication, which aligns VAT with other tax gaps and ensures the resources are deployed in the most efficient way.  We will confirm in the autumn the final decision and the expectation that the next publication of the VAT gap will be as part of Measuring Tax Gaps in 2027.

  5. 6 July 2026

    HMRC has deferred publication of the Direct Effects of Illustrative Tax Changes Bulletin to allow for a completion of a review of the key assumptions underpinning some of the estimates in the bulletin. An updated publication date will be announced in due course.

    The Direct effects of illustrative tax changes publication will be published on 7 July 2026.
